summary: MDJM LTD filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release confirming its Class A ordinary shares (par value US$0.875) are quoted on the OTCQB Venture Market under ticker UOKAF. The release clarifies the company's OTC market tier classification; no stake, price, premium, or board recommendation is discussed. This is a routine disclosure of a quotation change, not a special situation. It does not involve an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change. The filing is a routine current report by a foreign private issuer. No deal terms are applicable.
